summary: Paramount Gold Nevada Corp. filed a Form 8-K on July 14, 2026, disclosing the filing of a technical report summary (TRS) for its Grassy Mountain Gold Project, effective May 27, 2026, prepared under Regulation S-K Subpart 1300. The TRS and consents of qualified persons from Ausenco, RESPEC, WSP USA, Geotechnical Mine Solutions, and SLR International were attached as exhibits. This is a routine technical disclosure for a mining project, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or similar event is involved. The filing serves as an update on mineral resource/reserve estimates, with no deal terms or strategic change.
